paragraphs.text: Vara Beth Hannifer is a human from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding.

Vara is a renowned and strategic outlaw on Thunder Junction . A human with black hair and brown skin, she stands out in her Outcasters attire. She wears cactus and fur armor, characteristic of the Outcasters' naturalistic style. Vara wields a particularly large thundercaster, which she uses while mounted. Her ability to pick targets strategically and strike when least expected makes her a formidable figure in the criminal world. Her reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by her ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on her back.
